item.name: Require a token for Inventory Advisor
Reject customer access to Inventory Advisor

exec: pm.test('Inventory report uses verified metrics', () => { const data = envelope.data; pm.expect(data.policy.salesDays).to.equal(30); pm.expect(data.aiAssisted).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(data.summary.productsAnalyzed).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(data.recommendations).to.be.an('array'); });
